title: I got to try out the new iPad Pro, and it's clear that it's Apple's biggest update to the iPad lineup in years (AAPL)
text: I got to try out the new iPad Pro, and it's clear that it's Apple's biggest update to the iPad lineup in years (AAPL) Tuesday, 30 October 2018 ( 24 minutes ago ) NEW YORK CITY — If you want an iPad, any iPad, you can buy a new one for $329. But if you plan to run Photoshop, play advanced games, or use Apple's stylus, called Pencil, you'll want the iPad Pro . Apple updated its iPad Pro lineup on Tuesday with two new models: one with a 11-inch screen, and one with a 12.9-inch ...
